prompt: Write PostgreSQL query to return top 3 clients by revenue with no unpaid invoices older than 40 days.
chain_of_thought:
1. Subquery finds clients with unpaid invoices where days_outstanding > 40.
2. Filter out those client IDs from main query.
3. Aggregate SUM(amount_total) grouped by client.
4. Order by total descending and limit to 3.

ground_truth_solution.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(i.amount_total) AS total_revenue FROM clients c JOIN invoices i ON c.id = i.client_id WHERE c.id NOT IN (SELECT client_id FROM invoices WHERE status = 'unpaid' AND days_outstanding > 40) GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3;
